episodes.synopsis: Some time after the events that saw them return to El-Hazard, Makoto Mizuhara, the recently wed Mr. Fujisawa, and the Priestesses of Muldoon, including the newly appointed Priestess of Water Qawoor Towles, are gathered for Qawoor's initiation ceremony. However, during the ceremony, Katsuhiko Jinnai, ever the schemer, attempts to infiltrate Makoto's laboratory.
episodes.title: First Night: The Disappearance of the Priestess of Water

episodes.synopsis: Scattered across the unfamiliar world of Cretaria after the dimensional shift, the group struggles to find their bearings. Makoto Mizuhara finds himself separated from most of his friends, while Rune Venus and Princess Fatora (who has also been transported) discover they are in a strange, royal-looking palace.
episodes.title: Second Night: The Door to the Future Opens

episodes.synopsis: Still separated and stranded in the new world of Cretaria, Makoto Mizuhara and his allies continue their efforts to regroup. This episode focuses on the harsh, icy region where Shayla-Shayla and Katsuhiko Jinnai have inadvertently landed.
